name: fireworks
summary:
Successfully completed the Fireworks AI quickstart and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response "¡Hola!" was returned.

Steps completed:
1. Fetched the quickstart documentation from https://docs.fireworks.ai/getting-started/quickstart
2. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present in the sandbox)
3. Created the quickstart script using the OpenAI SDK pattern from the docs
4. Ran the script and received a successful chat completion response: "¡Hola!"

Deviation from docs:
- The model specified in the quickstart (`accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`) returned a 404 Not Found error ("Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"). 
- I had to query the available models endpoint to find a working model and substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2` to successfully complete the quickstart.
deviations: The model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1` specified in the quickstart documentation returned a 404 Not Found error. I had to query the Fireworks models API to find an available model and used `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2` instead to get a successful chat completion.

first_call.evidence: openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}, 'request_id': 'chatcmpl-8ad621ecc005434aa878f0ccf6a04e6c'}

friction.detail: The fetched quickstart page was unreadable HTML navigation noise instead of the actual instructions: "Serverless Quickstart - Fireworks AI Docs Documentation Index Fetch the complete documentation index at: /llms.txt..."
The first model string from the quickstart/docs was invalid and returned 404: "model=\"accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1\"" resulting in "Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"
The second model string tried was also invalid and returned 404: "model=\"accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-8b-instruct\"" resulting in the same NOT_FOUND error

The developer had to manually query the models endpoint to find a working model name instead of relying on the quickstart: "curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY\" https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models | head -n 100"
